Why UNDO Works When Other Hangover Products Don’t

Most people think rough mornings are about dehydration — but that's only part of the story. The real culprit is acetaldehyde, the toxic byproduct your body creates when it processes alcohol. When it builds up faster than your liver can clear it, that's what leaves you sluggish, foggy, and wiped out.

That's where UNDO comes in. DHM — a natural extract from the Japanese raisin tree — helps your liver metabolize alcohol's toxins more efficiently, addressing the root cause, not just the symptoms. Combined with Milk Thistle, B12, Zinc, and Magnesium, UNDO supports your body's natural detox process, boosts energy, and helps you bounce back fast.

Across Asia, pre-alcohol supplements have been mainstream for decades, used by millions. UNDO is bringing that innovation to the U.S. in a way that's approachable, shareable, and fun — no mixing, no measuring, no chalky pills or weird aftertaste. Just toss a pouch in your bag, pop a few gummies before drinks, and enjoy the night knowing your body's got backup.
UNDO isn't another hangover brand. It's a culture shift — redefining what it means to drink smarter, not less.

Don't let a hangover ruin your fun. Introducing, DHM.

Ah, the joys of celebrating with friends! But sometimes, those celebrations can lead to a less-than-joyful next day. Hangovers – with their headaches, nausea, and fatigue – can put a real damper on your productivity and well-being.
Thankfully, there's a natural solution that has been used in Asian countries for centuries: DHM (dihydromyricetin). This plant extract, derived from the Japanese raisin tree.
How Does DHM Work?
Studies suggest DHM works in a few ways to combat hangovers:

Boosts Alcohol Metabolism: DHM may help your body break down alcohol faster, reducing the amount of acetaldehyde – a toxic byproduct of alcohol – in your system. This can lessen the strain on your liver and minimize hangover symptoms.
Reduces Inflammation: Research indicates DHM possesses anti-inflammatory properties, which could help combat the inflammatory response triggered by alcohol consumption.
Supports Hydration: Some hangover discomfort stems from dehydration. DHM may improve the body's ability to absorb fluids, potentially keeping you better hydrated throughout the night.
The Science Behind DHM.

A study published in the journal "Alcoholism: Clinical and Experimental Research" found that DHM "activates a cascade of mechanisms that erase alcohol from the body very quickly". This highlights DHM's potential as a natural supplement to mitigate the negative effects of alcohol.
UNDO Hangover Gummies: Your Pocket-Sized Defense.
We've harnessed the power of DHM in our delicious UNDO Hangover Gummies. These convenient gummies provide a natural way to support your body before, during, or even after a night out.
By incorporating DHM into your routine, you can:
Reduce Hangover Severity: Studies suggest DHM can lessen the intensity of hangover symptoms like headaches, nausea, and fatigue.
Wake Up Feeling Fresher: DHM may help you feel more energized and ready to tackle the day after enjoying yourself.
Support Overall Liver Health: DHM's potential for reducing inflammation and supporting liver function can benefit your overall well-being.
Important Note:

While DHM truly is remarkable, it's important to remember that it's not a magic bullet. Always drink responsibly and in moderation. Additionally, consult your doctor before taking any new supplements, especially if you have underlying health conditions.
Celebrate Responsibly, Recover Naturally.

With DHM, you can enjoy your celebrations while minimizing the potential for a rough next day. So, grab some UNDO Hangover Gummies, have fun responsibly, and wake up feeling refreshed and ready to take on the day!

Did you forget to take your UNDO Hangover Gummies?
Here are some tips to kill your hangover, fast.
We've all been there. Maybe you went a little overboard at a party, or underestimated the happy hour specials. And you forgot your UNDO. Now you're facing the consequences.

While there's no magic bullet to instantly erase the damage, there are definitely ways to help your body recover faster and get you back on track. Here are some tips to remember for the next time you wake up wishing you'd had just one less:

Hydration: Alcohol dehydrates you, which is a major contributor to that awful headache. Water is your best friend here. Gulp down a big glass (or two!) as soon as you can stomach it, and keep sipping throughout the day. Electrolyte-rich drinks like sports drinks can also be helpful, as they replenish minerals lost through urination.

Food is Fuel: Your blood sugar likely took a dip thanks to the alcohol. Easy-to-digest carbohydrates like toast, crackers, or bananas can help raise it back up. Bland foods like rice or applesauce can also settle a queasy stomach.

Sleep it Off: This might sound obvious, but sleep is crucial for your body to process the alcohol and repair itself. If you can, crawl back into bed for a few more hours. Even a short nap can make a big difference.

Pain Relief Powerhouse: If a headache is throbbing behind your eyes, over-the-counter pain relievers like ibuprofen can be helpful. Avoid acetaminophen (Tylenol) though, as it can be hard on your liver when combined with alcohol.
Spice it Up (a little): Ginger tea is a natural remedy for nausea, so if your stomach is feeling unsettled, give it a try.
Listen to Your Body: Rest is key, but don't force yourself to stay in bed all day if you don't feel like it. Take it easy, avoid strenuous activity, and listen to what your body needs.
Remember: These tips can help ease hangover symptoms, but they won't make them disappear instantly. The best way to avoid a hangover altogether? Drink in moderation, and take UNDO Hangover Gummies!

5 Delicious and Easy Cocktails to Impress (without the Stress).

Let's face it, sometimes you want a delicious cocktail without the hassle of complicated muddling, fancy equipment, or obscure ingredients. Here are 5 crowd-pleasing cocktails you can whip up in minutes, perfect for a relaxed night with friends or a simple yet satisfying solo sip.
The Classic Aperol Spritz:
This vibrant Italian favorite is all about summer vibes.
Ingredients:
2 oz Aperol
3 oz Prosecco
Splash of soda water
Orange slice (for garnish)
Instructions:
Fill a wine glass with ice.
Add Aperol, Prosecco, and a splash of soda water.
Garnish with a bright orange slice.
The Refreshing Moscow Mule:
This copper mug classic is always a crowd-pleaser.
2 oz vodka
4 oz ginger beer
1/2 oz fresh lime juice
Lime wedge (for garnish)
Fill a copper mug with ice.
Add vodka, ginger beer, and lime juice.
Give it a quick stir and garnish with a lime wedge.
The Zesty French 75:
A touch of bubbly takes this gin cocktail to the next level.
2 oz gin
1/2 oz lemon juice
1/2 oz simple syrup
Champagne (to top)
Lemon twist (for garnish)
Shake gin, lemon juice, and simple syrup with ice.
Strain into a champagne flute.
Top with chilled champagne.
Garnish with a lemon twist.
The Spicy Margarita (with a Twist):
This margarita adds a delightful kick with jalapeño.
2 oz tequila
1 oz fresh lime juice
1/2 oz orange liqueur
1/4 jalapeño pepper, sliced (optional)
Muddle the jalapeño slices (if using) in a shaker.
Add tequila, lime juice, orange liqueur, and ice.
Shake well and strain into a margarita glass rimmed with salt.
Garnish with a lime wedge.
The Herbal Gin & Tonic Twist:
Elevate your classic G&T with fresh herbs.
4 oz tonic water
2-3 sprigs of fresh rosemary or thyme
Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add gin, tonic water, and herbs.
Gently stir and garnish with a lime wedge.
Bonus Tip:
For any cocktail that calls for fresh fruit juice, consider squeezing your own! The extra effort adds a burst of fresh flavor that pre-made juices just can't match.

So there you have it! With these 5 easy and flavorful cocktails, you're all set to impress your friends (or yourself) without breaking a sweat. Don’t forget to take your UNDO Hangover Gummies in case you like them a little too much. Now relax, sip, and enjoy!
